report_evidence.example_masked: 2026-08-31 (last calendar day: 30 days under the AT2 example table)

fields.finding: The cell is thin: it gives neither the admitted values (AT2 campo 16: X all systems, P pension only; R, C, T restricted to independent contributor types) nor the day rule (campos 36-39 may be below 30 only with an ING or RET event; a termination on the last calendar day reports 30) nor the source of the date. Internal inconsistency: G79, Field Options D139 and Population Rules C12 say campo 81 'becomes mandatory' when RET is marked, while G156 (campo 81 itself) correctly quotes AT2 ('Es un campo opcional cuando se reporte la novedad de retiro').

report_evidence.example_masked: 0 / 0 for both leavers on a run that pays 62116, 62181, 62700 only

fields.finding: The spec's own sources already keep the final-settlement concepts out of the IBC: rows 108-109 build the base from salary-constituting pay only ((a) 70% for an integral salary) plus the Ley 1393 excess (b); NIE115 (CO-DIAN-001) states that compensated vacation is NOT part of the contribution base; PILA Population Rules C19 keeps the 40% add-back out of the statutory-benefit base. Vacation paid in cash (62116 / 79403), the dismissal indemnity (62180 / 62181) and cesantias (62110 / 62117) are not salary (CST art. 128; CST art. 64; CST art. 249) and the October settlement run confirms the client computes no base on them. Two points remain: (1) the client's table flags 62116 and 79403 as 'Parafiscales' (campo 95 base) while the October run shows zero employer contributions - client to explain; (2) whether termination payments enter the Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30 40% test is an RA query (UGPP Acuerdo 1035 de 2015 numerals 2-3 were annulled by the Consejo de Estado on 17 Sep 2020), added to the appendix queries T2R2-042 / T2R2-044; no spec change from two employees.
fields.official_source: CST arts. 64, 128, 249; Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30; Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17; spec rows 108-109, NIE115, Population Rules C19

RA to state which document(s) carry FechaRetiro when the settlement is paid in a later month (both, or the termination-month document only) before the wording is aligned; the source field for the date is also a client question (no system field evidenced). fields.name: Indemnizacion (row 180)

report_evidence.example_masked: '63124 - INDEMNIZACION' base 46,555,828.75 (salary + average IC), 129.17 days = 200,453,880; '21129 - PERSONAL INCOME TAX WITHHOLDING- TERMINATIONS' 20% on 150,340,410 = 30,068,000
20 + 109.17 days, valor dia 1,551,860.96; 'Base indemizaciones' 10,684,296 (= 204 UVT); Renta 25% 50,113,470; Base gravable 150,340,410; valor rete 30,068,000

fields.finding: The wage type (62181) and the element are right and the client maps 62180 / 62181 to Indemnizacion. The tax sentence of the cell is wrong in law: the dismissal indemnity does not enter the ordinary monthly ET art. 383 / 388 base; it is withheld separately under ET art. 401-3 at 20% where the employee earns more than 204 UVT (no withholding below), after the 25% exempt income - exactly what the client practises through WT 21129. The settlement form labels the line with code 63124 (a day-counter wage type in the client's table) while the run carries 62181: a form label, not a mapping.
fields.proposed_explanation: Replace the first paragraph of M180 with: 'Indemnity for dismissal without just cause (CST art. 64), reported at its gross amount. It is NOT merged into the ET art. 383 / art. 388 monthly withholding base: it is withheld separately under ET art. 401-3 at the flat 20% where the employee's monthly income exceeds 204 UVT (COP 10,684,296 in 2026) and is not withheld below that threshold, after the 25% exempt labour income of ET art. 206 num. 10 within its statutory limit; only the statutory-minimum indemnities of ET art. 206 nums. 1-3 are exempt, and then only up to the legal minimum (art. 206 par. 1). The withholding so practised is WT 21129 'Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations' and is reported in RetencionFuente (NIE177) together with WT 2552.' Second paragraph (Source) unchanged.
fields.official_source: ET art. 401-3 (Ley 788 de 2002 art. 92); ET art. 206 nums. 1-3, 10 and par. 1; CST art. 64

fields.name: Pension income base / withholding (rows 24-25)
fields.finding: No pension income in the round-3 termination files.

confirmed: Termination settlements are run under their own payroll id: REF-P203-119 (generated 2026-10-06, pay group CO - Monthly, 2 employees), distinct from the September runs REF-P201-090 (Monthly) and REF-P201-184 - supports Form 350 row 23 ('accumulate by the payroll engine's run key', 'termination and settlement runs alike').

Wage types 62116 'Vacation Terminations' (both leavers) and 62181 'Severance/Layoff Payment- Non CLA' (leaver 2) are present as columns - supports CO-DIAN-004 casillas 42 / 46, CO-DIAN-001 NIE116 / NIE160, CO-DIAN-002 row 23 (62116 named).

2552 present on both rows and, for leaver 2, equal to the settlement's 2552 + 21129 - supports CO-DIAN-004 casilla 60 and CO-DIAN-001 NIE177 (21129 is withholding actually practised and reported with 2552).

'Days Worked' 0 and no salary wage type on the settlement run - supports NIE070 (no SueldoTrabajado on a settlement-only document) and the statement that the termination-month salary is paid in the regular run.

'Social Security Bases' 0 and 'Employer Contributions' 0 on a run paying vacation in cash, the indemnity and a non-salary allowance only - supports PILA rows 108-112 (IBC built from salary-constituting pay) and NIE115 (compensated vacation outside the contribution base).

Net Pay equals the settlement form's 'NETO A PAGAR' for both leavers, with the informative pairs (65814/21563, 65815/21802, 65817/25837) outside 'Total Deductions' - supports the NIE193 / NIE195 pairing and NIE189 (ComprobanteTotal = cash net).
contradicted: 'Effective Leaving Date' is blank for both leavers even on the settlement run (and in the Accruals sheet): the G2N does not evidence the termination date; only the manual settlement form does. No spec maps this column, but Contract.End_Date (PILA T2R2-081, NIE003, Form 220 casilla 31) has no evidenced source field - client question.
'Days Worked' = 30 in the September run for the 15-September leaver (NIE069 rule 'a mid-month leaver reduces it'): client practice of settling after the regular cycle; spec rule kept.
'Salary Assigned' = 0 for leaver 1 on the settlement run (NIE062 'never below 1 SMMLV'): evidence for the open point NIE062.

The G2N has no separate column for WT 21129: the '2552 - Income Tax (employee)' column carries the termination withholding too (48,095,372 = 18,027,371.65 + 30,068,000). Spec statements that 21129 'coexists with 2552' remain true at wage-type level; the engine must not add 21129 twice when reading a G2N-style total.

summary.leavers: Two integral-salary leavers (WT 62140): termination 2026-08-31 (file 1) and 2026-09-15 (file 2); both settlements paid in the October run REF-P203-119; no cesantias, interest, prima or fund deposit on either (CST art. 132 num. 2); vacation in cash 62116 on both; indemnity 62181 (200,453,880, 129.17 days, ET art. 401-3 withholding 30,068,000 as WT 21129) on file 2.
